title: Brand A/NAV and animated entry splash
changes: The visible brand, page title and header label read A/NAV instead of A.NAV
A full-screen entry splash in the site's beige shows the logo large in the centre, fades it in and then fades the whole screen out (about 2.5s)

The splash appears on the first visit after 5 minutes away, after the site was updated (page last-modified changed) and on a manual reload; it is skipped for reduced-motion users and can be dismissed by click or key
It keeps its own storage key (anav.splash.v1); the main data key is untouched
